_comment: Thread messages for DW1's thread agent (tickets 30 and 31, dw_sales ADR 0012) whose meaning leans on the thread: an earlier message, the case's lines, a number, an item code, PC's answer. Each is read with the read-only tools bound to its customer (`binding`: the case views and earlier messages code would bind); `gold` is the set of thread intents by the prompt's own definitions, `tools` the tools a careful reader would call (reported, not required: a model that reads it right without them is right). Every company, person, address, code and number here is fictional; the customers and items are the mock sample set's.
